name: MAPPA gritty realism
summary: Thin precise lines and restrained shading in a muted, film-graded real city, with lens grain and sudden saturated blood red.

traits.line: thin, precise, detailed lines; eye detail down to tear ducts and lower lash lines
traits.shading: restrained two-tone cel shadow, low contrast between tones, subtle gradient overlays
traits.palette: muted, desaturated city tones: concrete grey, olive, dusty blue, nicotine beige; saturated crimson reserved for blood and violence; purple-black cursed energy in Jujutsu Kaisen
traits.lighting: naturalistic and motivated: overcast daylight, fluorescent office light, sodium streetlamps; soft contrast like graded live action
traits.faces: near-realistic proportions, smaller eyes than typical TV anime, restrained expressions
traits.backgrounds: realistic Tokyo streets, alleys, apartments, convenience stores, painted with lived-in dirt and clutter
traits.texture: light film grain, mild chromatic aberration, lens blur and depth of field in compositing
traits.camera: film-like angles: low static 'tatami' shots, extreme long shots, first-person close-ups

style_words: Modern digital TV anime with grounded cinematic realism, as in Jujutsu Kaisen (2020) and Chainsaw Man (2022): thin precise lines, restrained low-contrast two-tone cel shading, muted desaturated urban palette of concrete grey, olive and dusty blue, naturalistic motivated light, detailed lived-in city backgrounds, light film grain and lens blur, sudden saturated crimson.
avoid: bright glossy shonen colours and big sparkling eyes
turning into a photograph or live-action still
flat uniform lighting with no motivated source
